items.title: US won't let China impose 'hegemony' in Asia, Hegseth says
items.description: The US Defense Secretary addressed Asia's most important defence summit, but did not mention Taiwan as questions remain over a stalled weapons package.

items.title: Ukraine war reaches 'a new phase', where Kyiv has the advantage
items.description: Ukraine has developed AI-enabled drones capable of making precision strikes from hundreds of kilometres away, and it means using Russia's vital logistics routes has become a dangerous "lottery".

items.title: Mum pulls kids out of AFL Auskick as integrity failures exposed
items.description: Several families tell the ABC they have been failed by the AFL Integrity Unit following bullying, racism and harassment.

items.title: Will AI become conscious? What a philosopher and a neuroscientist think
items.description: The question "can computers think" is something many people are taking very seriously. A philosophy professor believes we could be heading towards a future with conscious machines, while a neuroscientist is sceptical.

items.title: Donald Trump's doctor says he's in excellent health
items.description: Donald Trump's medical report shows the US president underwent a CT scan, cancer screenings and other preventative assessments carried out by 22 specialists.

items.title: Teen's extraordinary recovery after surviving 'most extensive' shark bite
items.description: Fourteen-year-old Sam Nai survived a devastating shark attack with a desperate swim for survival, followed by 20 surgeries to reconstruct his abdomen.

items.title: Live: Swans complete crushing win over Tigers ahead of key Lions-Dockers clash
items.description: Charlie Curnow finishes with eight goals in Swans's crushing win over Richmond, before the Brisbane Lions face a tough task against the high-flying Fremantle at the Gabba. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Lowly Eels threatening to spoil Knights' bid to enter NRL top four
items.description: The Newcastle Knights can end the day inside the NRL top four, but the lowly Parramatta Eels are pushing them at Hunter Stadium. Follow live.

items.title: Pleas for French Open to move 'unsafe' ad boards after star's nasty fall
items.description: Iga Świątek urges French Open officials to move advertising boards away from the courts after seeing Zeynep Sönmez's tournament end due to injury.

items.title: Australians are watching scrutiny of the Bondi attack through a keyhole
items.description: For now, Australians seeking to understand any intelligence gaps, failures, missed warnings and government failings before the Bondi massacre are expected to accept a keyhole view.

items.title: 'Notorious' shell company frontman arrested on the Gold Coast
items.description: A Queensland jetski salesman who helped set up offshore shell companies embroiled in scandals involving Mexican drug cartels and North Korean arms dealers faces extradition to the United States on money laundering charges.

items.title: Lil' Kim brings nostalgia to Vivid Sydney as festival continues
items.description: Rap superstar Lil' Kim performed mostly truncated versions of her hits at her Vivid Sydney show, but she gave the diehard fans in the audience exactly what they came for.

items.title: The 1970s oil shock gave birth to permaculture. This fuel crisis is reviving it
items.description: The tenets of permaculture are attracting a new generation of home gardeners. It's perhaps no surprise, considering the movement has firm roots in the world's last oil crisis in the 1970s.

items.title: David Szalay was ambushed with an AI sequel to his prize-winning novel
items.description: The Booker Prize winner sat down at the Sydney Writers' Festival to ponder the threat of AI to fiction, share some recommendations and consider whether his book was really about masculinity.

items.title: Transform tinned tuna into a crunchy, golden dinner
items.description: Kishwar Chowdhury says this nostalgic dish is "the ultimate Bangladeshi diaspora invention".

items.title: We asked for your modern dating love stories — here is what you told us
items.description: From instant connections to immediate rejections to a sudden change of fate, ABC readers take us on an emotional rollercoaster ride with their modern dating experiences.

items.title: The simple, ordinary joy of Kylie Minogue
items.description: In the end, a woman who's had wins and losses, terrors and triumphs, and who regularly goes back to stay with family in suburban Melbourne, has become a music legend of her time, and it's not hard to figure out why.

items.title: 'It's horrendous': Australian diver describes conditions as first cave survivor rescued
items.description: Rescue divers in Laos have safely evacuated the first of five local villagers who had been trapped in a cave for more than a week by floodwaters.

items.title: Matthew Perry was 'on the right path' before inner circle betrayed him
items.description: A trusted assistant, two doctors, a middleman and the "Ketamine Queen": How Matthew Perry's inner circle preyed on the Friends star's addiction before his death.

items.title: Why do some people in the Pacific want to make themselves whiter?
items.description: Skin bleaching and lightening products are widely sold in Tonga, which is part of a region with a long history of colourism.

items.title: 'Stand up with us and for us': Artist's passions collide at surf comp
items.description: Surfer Jessi Rebel's journeys with art and identity have beaten similar paths — both inspired by one relative's sage piece of advice.

items.title: 'Stop the madness': Olympic stadium fight taken to IOC head office
items.description: Opponents of Brisbane's centrepiece Olympic stadium take their concerns directly to the IOC's headquarters in Switzerland as a critical deadline looms.

items.title: Australia's marathon queen thought she might never walk again
items.description: As a girl, Kaz Thorburn was told she would never play sport or have children. The mother of three has now run 551 marathons.

items.title: Jess Fox thrilled at World Cup silver in first race since tumour surgery
items.description: Jess Fox celebrates a silver medal at the Canoe Slalom World Cup in her first race nine months after an operation to remove a kidney tumour.

items.title: Hindley conquers 'epic' day to climb onto Giro podium
items.description: Australia's Jai Hindley moved to third overall in the 2026 Giro d'Italia after a "tough day out" on stage 19, helped by a superb sacrificial ride by teammate Giulio Pellizzari.
